_readme: The kept views (M12 step 5a): the table that was code in Options.cpp's --view handler,
moved here as DATA in the scene file's own spelling -- each `at` is the compass placement
{x east, alt, z north, az compass, pitch} SetFromCompass takes. --view NAME still reads this
file (data/views.json, F5's own file, may override a name), and scenes/merrimack.json
includes it, so any scene may start from one of these by `scene.view`.

views.name: jetty-north
views._at: on the north jetty a little in from its tip, looking back along it toward the range tower (F5 2026-09-01: keep this!)

views.name: entrance-low
views._at: off the jetty tips looking west into the entrance, low
